The '''Fersal Hills''' was a hilly region on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It was bordered by the [[Jiberah Plains]] to the north and the [[Mertuen Forest]] to the west.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fersal Hills were one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
